- **Comments to add:** 296, one per profile and distinct omitted rationale. They cover 225 profiles. 171 profiles need one, 44 need two, 5 need three, 4 need four and 1 needs six.
- **Matches linked:** 325, the ones this run closed. The 326th gap row is a match an analyst had already resolved, so I'd skip it. A comment announcing a closure on a match this run didn't close would be wrong.

2. Write 2 profiles first and read them back (comment shape, links, no duplicates), then the remainder in throttled batches of about 100.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ACME bulk closure — supplementary rationale comments (approved by operator, a-ce93).

WHY: the original run posted ONE comment per profile (the last row's rationale). 226 profiles had
several listed matches with different spreadsheet rationales, so 325 closed matches lacked their own
rationale. This adds one comment per (profile, distinct omitted rationale), verbatim from the
spreadsheet, linked via metadata.match_ids to the matches it covers.

Constraints: additive only (no edits to existing comments, no status/activity writes). A match is
linked only if it was closed BY THE RUN and is still 'closed' now. Idempotent: skipped if a comment
with the identical text already exists on the profile. Modes: plan | sample (2 profiles) | bulk.
"""
import os, sys, csv, json, time, collections, datetime
from pymongo import MongoClient
from bson import ObjectId
MODE = sys.argv[1]
TENANT = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
ADMIN_ID = "ADMINIDADMINIDADMINIDADMINID"
ADMIN_META = {"id": ADMIN_ID, "kind": "app", "name": "Example Admin"}
HEADER = "Bulk closure approved by Taylor on 14 October 2026 (supplementary rationale)"
RATE, BATCH = 0.05, 100
utc = lambda: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

plan = list(csv.DictReader(open("acme-readonly-plan.csv")))
aud = {r["match_id"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(open("acme-closeout-audit-rows.csv"))}
by = collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in plan:
    if r["planned_comment_text"]: by[r["profile_id"]].append(r)
body = lambda t: t.split("\n\n", 1)[-1].strip()
groups = collections.OrderedDict()
for p, v in by.items():
    posted = v[-1]["planned_comment_text"]
    for r in v:
        if r["planned_match_action"] == "close" and r["planned_comment_text"] != posted \
           and aud[r["match_id"]]["outcome"] == "MATCH_CLOSED_BY_RUN":
            groups.setdefault((p, body(r["planned_comment_text"])), []).append(r["match_id"])
items = sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[0][0])
print(f"mode={MODE} supplementary_comments={len(items)} profiles={len({k[0] for k,_ in items})} "
      f"matches={sum(len(v) for _,v in items)}")
if MODE == "plan": sys.exit(0)

cli = MongoClient(os.environ["DB_DSN"], serverSelectionTimeoutMS=15000)
C = cli["clm-svc"]["clm-svc.clm_comments"]; M = cli["core-svc"]["search_matches"]
if MODE == "sample":
    seen = []; sel = []
    for k, v in items:           # one profile with 1 and one with 2+ comments
        if k[0] not in seen and len(seen) < 2: seen.append(k[0])
        if k[0] in seen: sel.append((k, v))
    items = sel
ledger = open("acme-supp-ledger.jsonl", "a"); ins = skip = unlinked = 0
for n, ((p, text), mids) in enumerate(items, 1):
    live = {str(d["_id"]) for d in M.find({"_id": {"$in": [ObjectId(m) for m in mids]}, "review_status": "closed"}, {"_id": 1})}
    link = [m for m in mids if m in live]; unlinked += len(mids) - len(link)
    full = HEADER + "\n\n" + text
    if not link or C.find_one({"profile_id": p, "tenant_id": TENANT, "text": full, "deleted_at": None}):
        skip += 1; ledger.write(json.dumps({"ts": utc().isoformat(), "id": p, "kind": "supp_skip", "link": len(link)}) + "\n"); continue
    doc = {"created_at": utc(), "updated_at": None, "deleted_at": None, "_version": 1, "kind": "profile",
           "text": full, "match_id": "", "task_id": "", "profile_id": p, "tenant_id": TENANT,
           "created_by": ADMIN_ID, "created_by_meta": ADMIN_META, "updated_by": "",
           "updated_by_meta": {"id": "", "kind": "", "name": ""}, "metadata": {"match_ids": link}}
    rr = C.insert_one(doc); ins += 1
    ledger.write(json.dumps({"ts": utc().isoformat(), "id": p, "kind": "supp_comment_insert",
                             "comment_id": str(rr.inserted_id), "matches": link}) + "\n"); ledger.flush()
    time.sleep(RATE)
    if MODE == "bulk" and n % BATCH == 0: print(f"  ...{n}/{len(items)} inserted={ins}", flush=True); time.sleep(2)
print(f"inserted={ins} skipped={skip} unlinked_matches={unlinked}")
PY
